t: 莫宁总督萨多 (Thado) 成为阿瓦国王。
te: Gov. Thado of Mohnyin becomes King of Ava.
dz: 莫宁总督萨多 (Thado) 成为阿瓦国王。
de: Gov. Thado of Mohnyin becomes King of Ava.

t: 国王 Mohnyin Thado 正式登上艾瓦王位。
te: King Mohnyin Thado formally ascends to the throne of Ava.
dz: 国王 Mohnyin Thado 正式登上艾瓦王位。
de: King Mohnyin Thado formally ascends to the throne of Ava.

t: 林山叛军在东泉（今河内）发生的三同-楚同战役中战胜了明军。
te: Lam Sơn rebels emerge victorious against the Ming army in the Battle of Tốt Động – Chúc Động taking place in Đông Quan,…
dz: 林山起义：林山叛军在东泉（今河内）发生的三同-楚同战役中战胜了明军。
de: Lam Sơn uprising: Lam Sơn rebels emerge victorious against the Ming army in the Battle of Tốt Động – Chúc Động taking place in Đông Quan, in now Hanoi.
